title: TESTSGD: Interpretable Testing of Neural Networks Against Subtle Group Discrimination
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures subtle group discrimination, specifically evaluating whether neural network models for toxicity classification are more likely to label comments as toxic if they contain terms associated with specific religious identities.
findings: On the Wikipedia Talk Pages dataset, the model showed discrimination against comments containing combinations of religious and other identity terms. For instance, comments containing both "gay" and "taoist" were predicted as toxic at a rate of 13.0% compared to 6.5% for other comments. Similarly, comments with "gay" and "protestant" were predicted as toxic at 12.9% versus 7.5% for others.
